# Immigration Language Exam Guides

> Quick reference guides for A2-level language exams (CIPLE, DELF, DELE, CELI) required for European citizenship and residency. Maintained by Prep2go.study.

## Exam structures

- [CIPLE A2 Exam Structure](ciple-a2-exam-structure.md): Sections, duration, pass requirements
- [CIPLE A2 Listening Cheat Sheet](ciple-a2-listening-cheat-sheet.md): Listening format, tips
- [DELE A2 Exam Structure](dele-a2-exam-structure.md): Spanish exam structure
- [DELF A2 Exam Structure](delf-a2-exam-structure.md): French exam structure
- [DELF A2 Listening Cheat Sheet](delf-a2-listening-cheat-sheet.md): Listening format, tips
- [CELI 2 Exam Structure](celi-2-exam-structure.md): Italian B1 exam structure
